evidence.sourceLabel: USDA Forest Service FIA DataMart invasive plant tables
evidence.caveat: FIA is a sampled forest inventory and does not establish complete county distribution. Missing FIA detections never support verified absence or survey non-detection. This assertion records presence only at the county scope supplied by explicit FIA codes.
